models.name: Original Chudjak
models.material: Felt, cotton shirting and embroidered thread
models.description: An unimpressed face behind thick glasses. One soft hand lifts for a reluctant wave.
models.alt: Seated Chudjak doll with felt hair, thick glasses, sewn shirt and rounded feet.

models.name: Midnight Hoodie
models.material: Charcoal jersey with ribbed cotton cuffs
models.description: He tugs at a lined hood. The cords take a beat to settle against his chest.
models.alt: Bespectacled Chudjak in a charcoal hood with a deep lining and two hanging drawstrings.

models.name: Helmet Chudjak
models.material: Olive twill, webbing and padded felt
models.description: A padded field helmet slips with the tilt of his head. One hand nudges it back.
models.alt: Chudjak plush in a paneled olive helmet with a chin strap and a utility overshirt.

models.name: Patchwork Afterhours
models.description: Cream, burgundy and graphite panels pull together in a brief self-hug. One knee wears a repair.
models.alt: Patchwork Chudjak toy with a repaired knee, mismatched cuff and stitched fabric panels.

models.name: Silver Thread
models.material: Dark velour, satin and silver embroidery
models.description: A shoulder turn catches the silver embroidery. The zipper pull swings against the satin collar.
models.alt: Chudjak in a dark satin bomber jacket with a separate zipper pull and silver stitching.

models.name: Velvet Eclipse
models.material: Violet velvet with moon-gray lining and woven trim
models.description: He draws a velvet hood around his glasses, lowers it and gives a small wave.
models.alt: Violet velvet Chudjak with a lined hood, a moon-gray interior and a familiar deadpan face.

models.name: Desk Green
models.material: Moss-green molded PBT, cream stem and brushed steel
models.description: Raised sleepy eyes sit above a broad terracotta lip. A single press compresses the switch.
models.alt: Sculpted green Pepe keycap with sleepy raised eyes, a cream stem and a grounded metal socket.

models.name: Terminal Clear
models.material: Translucent jade polycarbonate and brass spring
models.description: The stepped clear wall exposes the spring. A point of light rises through the jade as it releases.
models.alt: Clear jade frog keycap with a visible internal stem and brass spring.

models.name: Night Shift
models.description: A small moon sits in the graphite cap. The far eye opens under load and settles back.
models.alt: Graphite and ivory sculpted frog keycap with a crescent inset beside the raised eyes.

models.name: Porcelain Pond
models.material: Ivory ceramic glaze, celadon and gold repair lines
models.description: Painted reeds curl around the ceramic face. A fine gold seam catches the light on release.
models.alt: Ivory glazed frog keycap with a celadon face and a fine gold repair seam.

models.name: Meteor Core
models.material: Faceted ironstone, polished nickel and amber resin
models.description: A warm inclusion sits inside the cut mineral shell. One reflection circles the inset.
models.alt: Dark faceted mineral frog cap with a bright amber inclusion and polished metal stem.

models.name: Black Opal Eclipse
models.material: Carved opal, silver and smoked metal
models.description: The opal cap lifts clear of its stem, revealing an eclipse, then seats itself in the switch.
models.alt: Dark opalescent frog keycap with a silver crescent over a smoked-metal switch housing.
